title: USF Configuration Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for configuration artefacts (env vars, files, keys, secret-bearing settings, provider/environment/proof/runtime/compose configuration). Each declares its kind (configuration-kinds), secret classification, and provider mode (provider-modes) / environment (environment-classes) / proof relevance. A secret-bearing setting MUST NOT carry its literal value (never leak secrets); generated configuration declares its source manifest (generated config is regenerated, not hand-edited). Governs the ontology concept Configuration. lifecycleState draft; not active.

value.$comment: Only permitted for non-secret settings; never the literal value of a secret.

allOf.$comment: Never leak a secret value: a secret-bearing setting MUST NOT carry a literal value.
If flagged secretBearing, the literal value MUST NOT be present.
Generated configuration declares its source manifest (regenerated, not hand-edited).
